violations.text: The presence of pests is not controlled as evidenced by flys in the South Location. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to continue to work with pest control to eliminate pests. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the two door refrigerator up stairs and the two door refrigerator located at the North Entrance. Gaskets must be maintained in good condition. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the Quat sanitizing solution for the upstairs three bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips for the upstairs three bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by equipment. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/04/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (second floor ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. CA - Ice was voluntarily disposed of. Ice machine to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 02/04/2025
